name: モーションブラー方向解析
algorithm: Motion Blur Direction — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes motion blur direction consistency for video forensic detection:

1. **動きBlur検出**: Blurred regions in each frame are identified by analyzing the directional spread of the local point spread function (PSF). Motion-blurred regions show characteristic elongated PSFs in the direction of motion.

2. **BlurDirection推定**: For each blurred region, the blur direction and magnitude are estimated. Natural motion blur direction should be consistent with the object's motion vector between adjacent frames — blur direction aligns with the displacement vector.

3. **グローバル-ローカルBlur一貫性**: Camera motion produces globally coherent blur (all objects blur in the same direction, adjusted for depth). Object motion produces local blur. The method verifies that the observed blur field is consistent with a combination of camera and object motion. Composited or generated content may show inconsistent blur directions between regions.

4. **顔-BackgroundBlurコヒーレンス**: When camera motion occurs, the face and background should show consistent motion blur. Deepfake composites may show the face with different blur than the background — either sharper (generated without blur accounting) or blurred differently (incorrect motion estimation).

5. **時間的BlurContinuity**: Motion blur should vary smoothly across frames — increasing with faster motion, decreasing with slower motion. The method tracks blur magnitude and direction temporally. Abrupt changes in blur characteristics without corresponding motion changes indicate manipulation or generation artifacts.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through motion blur direction analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
